z-m-34-13.title: U-k lapho imigqa emibili ifana: kokubili u-2 no-−2?
z-m-34-13.topic: Ama-equation ezimo: umbandela wokuthi imigqa emibili ifane, nokuhlangana (imigqa equkethe uhlamvu)
z-m-34-13.goal: Hlola ukuthi onke ama-k atholwe usebenzisa umbandela wokuthi ukwehla kulingana kunika ngempela imigqa efanayo, hlela amacala ahlangene, futhi uchaze ukuthi impendulo ingancika encazelweni yokuba nokufana.
z-m-34-13.material: Kunomugqa l₁: kx + 2y = 4 nomugqa l₂: 2x + ky = 4 (u-k uyinombolo yangempela). Kulo msebenzi, 'ukufana' kusho imigqa emibili ehlukene engahlangani, futhi uma ama-equation amabili engumugqa ofanayo, 'ahlangana' futhi awafani.
